m=await rlm.harness.create_memory(title='ARC task-ad530a4b: move isolated motif toward full color-2 line and insert color-8 bar', content='Validated task family task-ad530a4b. Grid background is uniform; a full horizontal row of color 2 acts as a reference line, and a separate small motif lies on one side. Output adds a full horizontal row of color 8 at the row just beyond the motif on the side away from the color-2 reference. If the motif is a single row segment several rows away, translate that segment to immediately next to the color-2 line, then place the full color-8 row on the next row outward from the reference (between relocated motif and its original/far side); erase the old motif location to background. Example solved 14x17: color-2 line at row 3 (0-based), segment color 3 cols 11-14 at row 12; output keeps line row3, places same segment at row4, full row of 8 at row5, and clears original row12. Other demos: marker at row4 under line row1 moved to row2, 8 row3; vertical motif adjacent to line on opposite side remained unchanged and 8 was added at its far end (row8). Do not simply replace the original motif row with 8 or put translated motif one row from its original location. Preserve dimensions and all unrelated cells.', path='arc', global_=True)
print(m)
